object.attr: as implemented: 7 digits is git's usual short form (USAGE.md). A link without an ack reads suspect, never reviewed (MELLON-TRACE-SRS). To be replaced by the full hash: Decided on 2026-11-10, with TRACE.
object.description: A link element shall hold the link's acknowledged commit as the first 7 hex digits of the commit's hash in an ack attribute, or leave the attribute out when the link has none.
